d: Long, vivid purple hair is styled with a single thick braid draped over the shoulder and short, choppy bangs. The eyes are a matching shade of vivid purple with a sharp, focused expression on a youthful face. A slender build is dressed in a white long-sleeved button-up blazer with a red tie, a short blue pleated skirt, white knee-high socks with purple straps, and brown loafers. Accessories include a black shoulder bag, a yellow armband on the left sleeve, and a long katana held in the left hand.
